# Sportiverse

> Sportiverse is an all-in-one sports app for clubs, leagues, and players. Manage your club, run your league, and track every match — built for the people who live and breathe sport. Available on iOS (TestFlight beta) and Android (beta access).

Website: https://sportiverse.no/

## Capabilities

- Live match scoring with real-time events (goals, cards, substitutions) — score and event updates, not video
- Automatic player and team statistics derived from recorded match events: goals, assists, cards, free kicks, corners, penalties, minutes — essentially everything the referee whistles, plus career totals and club records
- Data-driven player ratings calculated from match events, not votes or opinions
- League management with automatic standings, configurable point systems, and multiple divisions
- Training session scheduling and attendance tracking
- Social feed with automatically shared match highlights, results, and milestones; likes and comments
- Share results, highlights, and milestones from the app to other social platforms
- Club management: members, roles, teams, drills
- Cross-platform: iOS and Android with real-time sync; no web version yet
- Languages: English, Norwegian, Danish, Swedish
- Free — and always will be; GDPR-compliant, EU data storage for EU users; users must be 13+, under 18 requires parental consent
- Focus: grassroots football in any country, with the ambition of every sport
